summary: Mary River Aerodrome (YMV) is a remote Arctic airfield located on Baffin Island in Nunavut, Canada, serving the high-grade Mary River iron ore mining operation operated by Baffinland Iron Mines Corporation. Situated well above the Arctic Circle, it functions primarily as an industrial gateway, supporting fly-in fly-out workers and limited cargo flights to one of the world's richest iron ore deposits. The surrounding tundra landscape and proximity to Eclipse Sound give it a uniquely isolated, frontier character.
faqs:
Q: What is the main purpose of Mary River Aerodrome?
A: The aerodrome primarily serves the Mary River iron ore mine, transporting workers and light cargo to and from this remote Arctic site on Baffin Island.

Q: Are there commercial passenger flights to Mary River Aerodrome?
A: No scheduled commercial passenger service is available. Access is generally arranged through employer-organized charter flights linked to the mining operation.

Q: What is the closest community to the aerodrome?
A: The nearest settlements are small Inuit hamlets along Eclipse Sound, with the larger community of Pond Inlet located some distance to the northwest.

Q: What are the weather challenges for flying into YMV?
A: The aerodrome experiences harsh Arctic conditions including extreme cold, high winds, fog, and rapidly changing weather, which can restrict flight operations.
transport_tips: There is no public road access to Mary River Aerodrome; all travel is by air via charter aircraft typically departing from larger hubs such as Ottawa, Montreal, or Iqaluit. Visitors should coordinate transport well in advance through their employer or authorized charter operators, as walk-up access is not an option. Be prepared for significant weather-related delays, particularly during winter months when daylight hours are limited and conditions can change abruptly.
local_tip: Bring layered, expedition-grade cold-weather clothing even in summer—Arctic temperatures at this latitude can drop near freezing year-round, and the open tundra offers little shelter from biting winds off Eclipse Sound.
